C0422.title: DiDi Fined RMB 8.026 Billion by CAC for Excessive Collection of Personal Information
C0422.summary: On July 21, 2022, the Cyberspace Administration of China (CAC) published its administrative penalty decision from the cybersecurity review of DiDi Global Inc. The investigation established 16 violations of the Cybersecurity Law, Data Security Law, and Personal Information Protection Law, including unlawful collection of users' photo screenshots and excessive collection of clipboard data, facial recognition information, and precise location data, involving 64.709 billion pieces of personal information in total. The CAC fined DiDi RMB 8.026 billion, with additional RMB 1 million fines on CEO Cheng Wei and President Liu Qing. Originating from the cybersecurity review launched in July 2021, it is the largest administrative penalty to date in China's personal information protection domain.
